items.blocker: No-limit PEFT scorecards were pruned before artifacts were recovered.
operator_actions: Confirm `colab sessions` is empty or intentionally owned.
Retry only a single no-limit shard at a time, starting with the smallest selected task.
If keepalive/session pruning recurs, prefer a persistent backend instead of repeated Colab retries.

items.blocker: HF Jobs rejected the live route probe with insufficient prepaid credits.
operator_actions: Add Hugging Face prepaid credits or grant capacity.
Keep paid GPU submission explicitly confirmation-gated.
Submit the prepared scorecard only after credits are visible.

items.blocker: Azure CLI is installed but not currently logged in.
operator_actions: Run device-code login for the intended account.
Rerun quota checks before any workspace, compute, or job action.

items.blocker: NGC has no configured API key, SSO session, org/team, GPU quota, or benchmark container.
operator_actions: Authenticate with SSO or supplied API key without committing secrets.
Record non-secret org/team and Cloud Function GPU quota evidence.
Build or select an NGC registry benchmark container before any task submission.

items.blocker: Kaggle CLI is installed but unauthenticated.
operator_actions: Authenticate Kaggle CLI with OAuth or an API token.
Check weekly accelerator quota before pushing a kernel.
Push the staged kernel only after explicit confirmation.
